source_text: Ἐρῶ δὲ καὶ τοὺς λόγους, δι᾿ ὧν δηλοῦται μερίσας πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὁ θεός. Εἰσὶ δὲ οὗτοι· Ἐπερώτησον τὸν πατέρα σου, καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ σοι τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους σου, καὶ ἐροῦσί σοι. Ὅτε διεμέριζεν ὁ ὕψιστος ἔθνη, ὡς διέσπειρεν υἱοὺς Ἀδάμ., ἔστησεν ὅρια ἐθνῶν κατὰ ἀριθμοὺς υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἐγενήθη μερὶς κυρίου λαὸς αὐτοῦ Ἰακώβ, σχοίνισμα κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ Ἰσραήλ . Καὶ εἰπὼν ταῦτα ἐπήνεγκα λέγων ὅτι οἱ ἑβδομήκοντα ἐξηγήσαντο, ὅτι Ἔστησεν ὅρια ἐθνῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ἀγγέλων θεοῦ. Ἀλλ᾿ ἐπεὶ καὶ ἐκ τούτου πάλιν οὐδέν μοι ἐλαττοῦται ὁ λόγος, τὴν ὑμετέραν ἐξήγησιν εἶπον. Καὶ ὑμεῖς δ᾿, εἰ βούλεσθε τὴν ἀλήθειαν ὁμολογῆσαι, ὅτι πιστότεροι πρὸς τὸν θεόν ἐσμεν, οἵτινες διὰ τοῦ ἐξουθενημένου καὶ ὀνείδους μεστοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ σταυροῦ κληθέντες ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὧν καὶ τῇ ὁμολογίᾳ καὶ τῇ ὑπακοῇ καὶ τῇ εὐσεβείᾳ κολάσεις μέχρι θανάτου ὑπὸ τῶν δαιμονίων καὶ τῆς στρατιᾶς τοῦ διαβόλου, διὰ τῆς ὑφ᾿ ὑμῶν ἐκείνοις γεγενημένης ὑπηρεσίας, προστετίμηνται, πάνθ᾿ ὑπομένομεν ὑπὲρ τοῦ μηδὲ μέχρι φωνῆς ἀρνεῖσθαι τὸν Χριστόν, δι᾿ οὗ ἐκλήθημεν εἰς σωτηρίαν τὴν προητοιμασμένην παρὰ παρὰ τοῦ πατρός, ὑμῶν τῶν ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ καὶ ἐπισκοπῇ μεγάλης δόξης λυτρωθέντων ἀπὸ τῆς Αἰγύπτου, θαλάσσης ὑμῖν τμηθείσης καὶ γενομένης ὁδοῦ ξηρᾶς, ἐν ᾗ τοὺς διώκοντας ὑμᾶς μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς πάνυ καὶ ἐνδόξων ἀρμάτων, ἐπικλύσας αὐτοῖς τὴν δι᾿ ὑμᾶς ὁδοποιηθεῖσαν θάλασσαν, ἀπέκτεινεν · οἷς καὶ στύλος φωτὸς ἔλαμπεν , ἵνα καὶ παρὰ τὸν πάντα ἄλλον λαὸν τὸν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἰδίῳ καὶ ἀνελλιπεῖ καὶ μὴ δύνοντι φωτὶ χρῆσθαι ἔχητε· οἷς ἄρτον εἰς τροφὴν δι᾿ ἀγγέλων οὐρανίων, τὸ μάννα, ἔβρεξεν , ἵνα μηδὲ σιτοποιίας δεόμενοι ζητήσητε· καὶ τὸ ἐν Μερρᾷ ὕδωρ ἐγλυκάνθη · καὶ σημεῖον τοῦ σταυροῦσθαι μέλλοντος καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ὄφεων τῶν δακόντων ὑμᾶς, ὡς προεῖπον, γεγένηται (πάντα προλαμβάνοντος πρὸ τῶν ἰδίων καιρῶν τὰ μυστήρια χαρίζεσθαι ὑμῖν τοῦ θεοῦ, πρὸς ὅν ἀχάριστοι ἐλέγχεσθε ἀεὶ γεγενημένοι) καὶ διὰ τοῦ τύπου τῆς ἐκτάσεως τῶν χειρῶν Μωσέως καὶ τοῦ ἐπονομασθέντος Ἰησοῦ πολεμούντων τὸν Ἀμαλήκ, περὶ οὗ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς ἀναγραφῆναι τὸ γεγενημένον, φήσας καὶ εἰς τὰς ὑμῶν ἀκοὰς Ἰησοῦ παραθέσθαι τὸ ὄνομα, εἰπὼν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μέλλων ἐξαλείφειν ἀπὸ τῆς ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν τὸ μνημόσυνον τοῦ Ἀμαλήκ . Καὶ ὅτι τὸ μνημόσυνον τοῦ Ἀμαλὴκ καὶ μετὰ τὸν τοῦ Ναυῆ υἱὸν μένει, φαίνεται· διὰ δὲ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ σταυρωθέντος, οὗ καὶ τὰ σύμβολα ἐκεῖνα προκηρύγματα ἦν τῶν κατ᾿ αὐτὸν ἁπάντων, ὅτι μέλλει ἐξολοθρευθήσεσθαι τὰ δαιμόνια καὶ δεδιέναι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, καὶ πάσας τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς βασιλείας ὁμοίως ὑφορᾶσθαι αὐτόν, καὶ ἐκ παντὸς γένους ἀνθρώπων θεοσεβεῖς καὶ εἰρηνικοὺς δείκνυσθαι εἶναι τοὺς εἰς αὐτὸν πιστεύοντας, φανερὸν ποιεῖ, καὶ τὰ προανιστορημένα ὑπ᾿ ἐμοῦ, Τρύφων, σημαίνουσι. Καὶ τοσαύτη δὲ ὀρτυγομήτρα ἐδόθη ὑμῖν ἐπιθυμήσασι κρεωφαγίας, ὅση ἀνάριθμους εἰπεῖν · οἷς καὶ ἐκ πέτρας ὕδωρ ἀνέβλυσε, καὶ νεφέλη εἰς σκιὰν ἀπὸ καύματος καὶ φυλακὴν ἀπὸ κρύους εἵπετο , ἄλλου οὐρανοῦ καινοῦ τρόπον καὶ προαγγελίαν ἀπαγγέλλουσα· ὧν καὶ οἱ ἱμάντες τῶν ὑποδημάτων οὐκ ἐρράγησαν, οὐδὲ αὐτὰ τὰ ὑποδήματα ἐπαλαιώθη, οὐδὲ τὰ ἐνδύματα κατετρίβη, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ τῶν νεωτέρων συνηύξανε .
pass_a_gloss: But I will speak also the words by which it is made clear that God divided all the nations. And these are: Ask your father, and he will announce to you, and your elders, and they will say to you. When the Most High divided the nations, as he scattered the sons of Adam, he set the boundaries of the nations according to the number of the sons of Israel; and the Lord's portion became his people, Jacob, the measuring cord of his inheritance, Israel. And having said these things, I added, saying that the seventy interpreted that he set the boundaries of the nations according to the number of the angels of God. But since even from this the word is not diminished for me, I spoke your interpretation. And you, if you wish to confess the truth, that we are more faithful to God, who, having been called by God through the mystery of the cross, which is despised and full of reproach, and having been punished even to death by the demons and the army of the devil, because of the service rendered to them by you, we endure all things, so as not to deny Christ even with a word, through whom we were called to the salvation prepared by the Father, just as you were redeemed from Egypt, the sea having been divided for you and become a dry road, on which those who pursued you with great power and glorious arms, having been covered by the sea made by God through you, were killed; to whom also a pillar of light shone, so that you might have, unlike all other people in the world, your own and complete and unending light; to whom also bread, manna, was rained down through heavenly angels for food, so that you might not need to seek bread; and the water in Marah was sweetened; and a sign of the cross to come was given also to you, when the snakes that bit you were destroyed, as I said before, all these things being given to you by God beforehand, who always reproaches you for being ungrateful. And through the type of the outstretched hands of Moses and the one named Jesus, who fought against Amalek, about which God said to record what happened, saying also to your ears that the name of Jesus was given, saying that he is the one who will blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven. And that the memory of Amalek remains even after the son of Nun, is clear; but through Jesus, who was crucified, of whom those symbols were also a proclamation of all things concerning him, that the demons will be destroyed and will fear his name, and all the powers and kingdoms will similarly be subject to him, and people from every nation will be shown to be devout and peaceful, believing in him, this makes clear, and the things I previously narrated to you, Trypho, signify. And such a multitude of quails was given to you, who desired to eat flesh, as many as cannot be numbered; to whom also water flowed from a rock, and a cloud followed for shade from heat and protection from cold, announcing another new heaven and a proclamation; to whom also the thongs of their sandals were not torn, nor were their sandals worn out, nor were their clothes worn, but even the things of the younger ones were preserved.

pass_b_english: I will now speak the very words by which it is shown that God divided all the nations. Those words are: "Ask your father, and he will inform you; your elders, and they will tell you. When the Most High divided the nations, when he scattered the sons of Adam, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel; and the Lord's portion became his people Jacob, the measuring line of his inheritance, Israel" (Deuteronomy 32:8-9).

Having said this, I added that the Seventy interpreted the text as saying he set the boundaries of the nations according to the number of the angels of God. Yet even from this reading the argument is not weakened for me, so I put forward your interpretation as well.

And you, if you wish to confess the truth, that we are more faithful to God — we who have been called by God through the mystery of the cross, despised and full of reproach — we who are punished even to death by the demons and the army of the devil because of the service you rendered to them, we endure all things so that we may not deny Christ even with a word. It is through him that we were called to the salvation prepared by the Father.

Consider your own history: you were redeemed from Egypt, the sea divided for you and made a dry road. On that road your pursuers, with their great power and glorious chariots, were drowned when the sea God made a path through for you closed over them. To you a pillar of light also shone, so that you might possess, unlike every other people in the world, your own complete and unfailing light. To you bread, the manna, was rained down through heavenly angels for food, so that you would not need to seek bread. The water at Marah was sweetened. And a sign of the coming cross was given to you when the serpents that bit you were destroyed, as I said before — all these things granted beforehand by God, who always convicts you of being ungrateful.

Then there is the type of the outstretched hands of Moses and of the one named Jesus who fought against Amalek. God commanded that this event be recorded, saying also to your hearing that the name Jesus was given, declaring, "This is the one who will blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven." The memory of Amalek remained even after the son of Nun, but through Jesus who was crucified — of whom those symbols were a proclamation of all things concerning him — it is made clear that the demons will be destroyed and will fear his name, that all powers and kingdoms will likewise be subject to him, and that from every nation those who believe in him will be shown to be devout and peaceful. This confirms the things I previously narrated to you, Trypho.

Moreover, a multitude of quails beyond counting was given to you when you craved meat. To you water also gushed from a rock, and a cloud followed you for shade from the heat and shelter from the cold, announcing another new heaven and a proclamation. For you the thongs of your sandals did not break, nor did your sandals wear out, nor did your clothing wear away; indeed, even the garments of the younger ones grew with them.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the complex syntax of the Greek, particularly the long periodic sentence regarding the suffering of the Christians and the historical typology of the Exodus. Scripture citations (Deuteronomy 32:8-9) are correctly added to the English text to identify the allusion in the Greek. Pass A and Pass B are consistent with the Greek source.
